set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- The core 1.0 publication matrix marks ravel-laws nonpublished unless the full conformance-kit epic closes first.
- publish skip, local snapshot behavior, docs, and release notes agree.
- No stable compatibility promise is attached to the current assertion helpers or two constant Discipline properties.
- Core internal tests retain any useful helpers through nonpublished testkit scope.
- Artifact verification fails if ravel-laws appears unexpectedly in the core 1.0 candidate.
set.title: Exclude ravel-laws from core 1.0 until its contract is real
